---
title: Deduplicate a public bibliographic export
---

## Question

How can duplicate records be found in a public bibliographic export when titles and source metadata vary slightly?

## Data

A small OpenAlex works export cached under `data-raw/` and processed in `R/app-06-deduplication.R`.

## Linkage strategy

Treat the task as deduplication: block on publication year, compare titles and sources, and inspect high-score duplicate clusters.

## Result

The example shows how a deduplication workflow differs from linking two already distinct files.

## Reporting

Document the search query, download date, duplicate rules, and how near-duplicate titles were adjudicated.
